description: Search for company attribute change events across companies. Use this to find companies where a specific attribute recently changed, or to monitor for changes in a particular dimension (e.g. employee count drops). Returns events with company identifiers, previous/new values, and temporal bounds.

event_type.description: Event type filter (currently only 'attribute_changed' is supported)

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 50, max 200)

name: search_company_events
